[element-textual-form]
=== `<textual-form>` Textual Form

Container element (for Best Practice used only inside <<element-alternatives,`<alternatives>`>>) that will hold text and mixed content objects that act as alternatives to, for example, graphics.

* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
